mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% triggers a monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annual growth signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP (GDPC1) above 0.5% monthly rates indicates robust consumer demand, driving equity valuations higher over 60 trading days as consumption accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >60% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed 0.5% MoM for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% during low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%) signals tight labor markets that boost consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of periods where UNRATE < 5.0% and CPIAUCSL < 2.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) above 1.0% monthly growth indicates strengthening consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as demand expands.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >60% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds 1.0% MoM for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 0.5% monthly rate signals labor market strength that increases household income and spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output (INDPRO) above 100 combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) indicates robust industrial capacity and accommodative finance, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >60% of instances where INDPRO > 100 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 900k units combined with GDP growth above 1.0% quarterly rate indicates a housing-led demand surge, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >60% of periods where HOUST > 900 and GDPC1 > 1.0% QoQ for 3 consecutive months.
